Suriya Stars as Unconventional Cop in Jithu Madhavan's 'Scene' Trailer Ahead of Worldwide Theatrical Release

Trailer Release and Plot Overview

The official trailer for actor Suriya's upcoming film *Scene* has been unveiled, introducing an action-comedy mystery directed by Jithu Madhavan. Suriya stars as Inbaraj, an unconventional police officer attempting to leave the force while clashing with his superior officer, Stephen, played by Lal. The narrative pits Inbaraj against an intelligent and ruthless criminal named Eeswaran, portrayed by Naslen, while Nazriya plays a character named Maya.

According to reported details from the trailer, the storyline includes a comedic exchange where Inbaraj states an intention to enter politics upon resigning, a sequence noted as a possible indirect reference to actor Vijay's transition into political life.

Cast, Crew, and Musical Previews

*Scene* marks Jithu Madhavan's Tamil directorial debut following his previous films *Romancham* (2023) and *Aavesham* (2024). The main credited cast features:

  • Suriya as Inbaraj
  • Nazriya as Maya
  • Naslen as Eeswaran
  • Lal as Stephen
  • Anandraj and Raj Priyan in supporting roles

The film is produced by Suriya and Jyotika under Zhagaram Studios and 2D Entertainment. Ahead of the trailer, musical promotions included two songs composed by Sushin Shyam: the first single "Aathi Iva Yarraa" and the track "Aeroplane."

Release Information and Verification

  • Film Title: Scene (Suriya's 47th film)
  • Original Language: Tamil
  • Confirmed Theatrical Release Date: Worldwide on November 6, 2026, coinciding with the Deepavali/Diwali holiday period.
  • Release Format: Theatrical release confirmed by the makers; streaming partners or OTT platforms have not been announced.

Fans and interested viewers can verify release details and view the official trailer by checking actor Suriya's official social media channels, including his profile on X (formerly Twitter), or via official distributor announcements from Zhagaram Studios and 2D Entertainment.
